display.methodZh: 实测于 2026 年 11 月 3 日；固定提示词、温度 0、600 秒请求超时。推理费用报告为 $0；免费路由的额度与可用性可能变化。输出 token 已包含提供商报告的思考 token。
display.methodEn: Tested November 3, 2026, with fixed prompts, temperature 0 and a 600-second request timeout. Reported inference cost is $0; free-route quotas and availability can change. Completion tokens already include reported reasoning tokens.
display.officialIntroZh: 以下为 Dots Studio 官方模型卡图表，原字节保存并注明来源，2026-11-04 核对；未独立复现，与上方 TOKRACE 作品区分。
display.officialIntroEn: The following original-byte figures come from the Dots Studio model card, checked November 4, 2026. They are vendor-reported and not independently reproduced, separate from TOKRACE outputs.

tasks.title: 9:41 模拟钟表
rubricZh: 分针指向第 41 分钟（从 12 点顺时针 246°）
时针指向 9 点后 41 分钟（290.5°），且短于分针
rubricEn: Twelve numbers in the correct order
Minute hand at 246 degrees clockwise from 12
Shorter hour hand at 290.5 degrees, between 9 and 10

tasks.title: 数据图表与比例
rubricZh: Q1 到 Q4 的顺序、数值与总计 84 正确
四柱共享零基线，高度比例为 2:4:3:5
刻度、柱顶数字与摘要清楚，无遮挡
rubricEn: Correct quarter order, values and total of 84
Shared zero baseline and heights in the ratio 2:4:3:5
Readable axis, values and summaries without overlap

tasks.title: 中文海报与排版约束
rubricZh: 六段指定文字各一次，字词与数字不改写
标题、信息和按钮层次清晰
边距充足，文字在画布内且不重叠，自行车可辨识
rubricEn: All six exact Chinese strings appear once
Clear hierarchy of heading, details and button
Adequate margins, no clipping or overlaps, recognizable bicycle

tasks.title: 鹈鹕骑车动画
rubricZh: 长喙、喉囊和两轮车架可辨认
轮辐与脚踏转动，腿部连接自然
4 秒循环连贯，主体不出画布
rubricEn: Moving spokes and crank; coherent leg joints
Continuous four-second loop with no clipping

attempts.prompt: Return only a complete, self-contained static SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a clear analog clock showing exactly 9:41, with all twelve numbers 1 through 12. The hour hand must be correctly positioned between 9 and 10, not exactly on 9. The minute hand must indicate minute 41. Use a shorter hour hand and a longer minute hand, no second hand. Add a small label "09:41" below the dial. Do not use scripts, external assets or embedded images.

messages.content: Return only a complete, self-contained static SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a clear analog clock showing exactly 9:41, with all twelve numbers 1 through 12. The hour hand must be correctly positioned between 9 and 10, not exactly on 9. The minute hand must indicate minute 41. Use a shorter hour hand and a longer minute hand, no second hand. Add a small label "09:41" below the dial. Do not use scripts, external assets or embedded images.

attempts.assessmentZh: 12 个数字齐全，时针 290.556°、分针 246.005°，与 9:41 的目标位置相符；时针也短于分针。画面简洁，标签清楚。
attempts.assessmentEn: All twelve numbers are present. The hour hand is at 290.556° and the minute hand at 246.005°, matching 9:41 within coordinate rounding; the hour hand is shorter. The layout is simple and clear.

attempts.prompt: Return only a complete, self-contained static SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Design a polished dashboard card titled "Quarterly Revenue". Draw a vertical bar chart for Q1=12, Q2=24, Q3=18, Q4=30, in that left-to-right order. All four bars must share a zero baseline, and bar heights must be exactly proportional to the values. Show a y-axis labeled 0, 10, 20, 30 and show the value above each bar. Add summary labels "Total: 84" and "Best: Q4". Use a light background and readable typography. Do not use scripts, external assets or embedded images.

messages.content: Return only a complete, self-contained static SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Design a polished dashboard card titled "Quarterly Revenue". Draw a vertical bar chart for Q1=12, Q2=24, Q3=18, Q4=30, in that left-to-right order. All four bars must share a zero baseline, and bar heights must be exactly proportional to the values. Show a y-axis labeled 0, 10, 20, 30 and show the value above each bar. Add summary labels "Total: 84" and "Best: Q4". Use a light background and readable typography. Do not use scripts, external assets or embedded images.

attempts.assessmentZh: 四根柱共用零基线，高度比例 2:4:3:5 正确，总计 84、最佳 Q4 也正确。遗漏 Q1–Q4 横轴标签，读者无法直接辨认每根柱所属季度。
attempts.assessmentEn: The four bars share a zero baseline and the correct 2:4:3:5 ratio. Total 84 and Best Q4 are correct, but Q1–Q4 labels are missing from the horizontal axis.

attempts.prompt: 只输出一个完整、自包含的静态 SVG，viewBox="0 0 800 600"。设计一张清晰、精致的中文活动海报。必须且仅包含以下六段文字，每段出现一次，不能增删字或改写：主标题“周末骑行计划”；副标题“慢一点，看见城市”；时间“10月24日 09:00”；地点“滨江公园东门”；说明“自备头盔 · 全程12公里”；按钮文字“立即报名”。画一个简洁的自行车图标。主标题最大，时间地点次之，说明最小。背景浅色，留足边距，所有文字保持在画布内，不重叠，不使用脚本、外部素材或嵌入图片。

messages.content: 只输出一个完整、自包含的静态 SVG，viewBox="0 0 800 600"。设计一张清晰、精致的中文活动海报。必须且仅包含以下六段文字，每段出现一次，不能增删字或改写：主标题“周末骑行计划”；副标题“慢一点，看见城市”；时间“10月24日 09:00”；地点“滨江公园东门”；说明“自备头盔 · 全程12公里”；按钮文字“立即报名”。画一个简洁的自行车图标。主标题最大，时间地点次之，说明最小。背景浅色，留足边距，所有文字保持在画布内，不重叠，不使用脚本、外部素材或嵌入图片。

attempts.assessmentZh: 六段指定中文各出现一次，没有缺字、重叠或出界。标题和按钮层次清楚，自行车图标较简略，留白较多。
attempts.assessmentEn: All six exact Chinese strings appear once, without missing characters, overlap or clipping. Heading and button hierarchy are clear; the bicycle icon is rudimentary and the layout has generous whitespace.

attempts.prompt: Return only a complete self-contained animated SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a recognizable pelican riding a bicycle: long bill and throat pouch, two wheels, connected frame, saddle and handlebar. Animate rotating wheel spokes and a rotating crank with pedaling legs that remain attached to the rider and pedals. Use SVG SMIL animateTransform/animate/animateMotion only (no CSS animation), with a seamless 4-second repeating loop. Keep the whole bicycle and bird on the canvas. Use a light background. No scripts, foreignObject, external assets, external fonts or embedded images. Use only local SVG shapes and text. The animation must visibly move, not just contain animation tags.

messages.content: Return only a complete self-contained animated SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a recognizable pelican riding a bicycle: long bill and throat pouch, two wheels, connected frame, saddle and handlebar. Animate rotating wheel spokes and a rotating crank with pedaling legs that remain attached to the rider and pedals. Use SVG SMIL animateTransform/animate/animateMotion only (no CSS animation), with a seamless 4-second repeating loop. Keep the whole bicycle and bird on the canvas. Use a light background. No scripts, foreignObject, external assets, external fonts or embedded images. Use only local SVG shapes and text. The animation must visibly move, not just contain animation tags.

attempts.assessmentZh: 轮辐和脚踏确实转动，主体留在画布内，已导出可播放的 4 秒循环。腿被画成绕身体旋转的直杆，缺少屈膝关节，踩踏姿势不自然；车架也很简略。
attempts.assessmentEn: Spokes and pedals visibly rotate, the subject stays on canvas, and a playable four-second loop is delivered. The legs are rigid rods rotating around the body rather than articulated knees, so pedaling looks unnatural; the frame is rudimentary.

history.interruptionReason: Output token allowance reached before SVG content was returned.
